title: Certified Hold, Lower Confidence

sections.heading: The Check
sections.text: Did the completed Friday cycle justify changing the certified HGD posture?

sections.heading: What Actually Changed
sections.text: The posture held at Recovery Transition, but confidence is now low. The July 31 cycle preserved a defensive analytical allocation while keeping primary and secondary exposure present.

sections.text: Certified analytical Core state: primary 24.6%, secondary 16.4%, defensive 59.0%, avoid 0.0%. These are internal analytical buckets, not instrument-level implementation weights.
